title: Resignificando la tecnología para las lenguas indígenas

bias_targets.methodology: Literature review and analysis of the disparity in Natural Language Processing (NLP) resources, evaluating the underrepresentation and technological marginalization of indigenous and low-resource languages in large language models (LLMs) compared to dominant languages.

Qualitative and historical analysis of how technologies, from early writing systems to modern AI, impose dominant cultural paradigms, evaluating the systemic exclusion and devaluation of indigenous knowledge systems and epistemologies.

Analysis of statistical and census data (e.g., from the World Bank and INEGI) to evaluate the digital divide, highlighting disparities in internet connectivity, computer ownership, and mobile phone access between indigenous/rural communities and urban populations.
